io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide

Class SlimefunGuide

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.SlimefunGuide

  • public final class SlimefunGuide
extends java.lang.Object
    This is a static utility class that provides convenient access to the methods of SlimefunGuideImplementation that abstracts away the actual implementation.
    See Also:
    SlimefunGuideImplementation, SurvivalSlimefunGuide

      • getGuideMode

        @Nullable
public static SlimefunGuideMode getGuideMode(@Nullable
                                                       org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack item)
        Returns the SlimefunGuideMode stored on a guide ItemStack via its PDC tag, or null if the item is not a guide. Language-independent, so it still resolves after the guide has been re-skinned into a player's language.
        Parameters:
        item - The ItemStack to inspect
        Returns:
        The stored SlimefunGuideMode, or null

      • canUseCheatSheet

        public static boolean canUseCheatSheet(@Nonnull
                                       org.bukkit.entity.Player p)
        Whether the given Player may use the Cheat Sheet, based on the admin-configured access toggles (guide.cheat-sheet.*). Access is granted when ANY enabled rule matches. Defaults: OPs and players with the slimefun.cheat.items permission.
        Parameters:
        p - The Player
        Returns:
        Whether this player may open the Cheat Sheet
